capabilities_done: slice 1 composite::composition (default build, folio-free, motion-free): SceneComposition/SceneLayer/SceneTile evaluated frame (layers bottom-first, content matrix content-plan -> composition pixels), lower_scene (isolated root group over (0,0,w,h), background Solid, exact integer moves without envelope, other invertible matrices -> pigment LayerExtension.transform with the scene's declared filter, singular matrix / opacity 0 skipped, transform_multi_tile_layer), render_scene (caller RenderBackend -> full-frame straight-alpha surface, bytes charged before allocation, backend refusal TemporalError::Render)

slice 1 composite::temporal::composition (feature motion): CompositionTemporalSource::new(CompositionInput) validates the records with folio validate_composition_records, reads layer timing windows, authored appearance (blend mode, opacity, fill), position/scale/rotation/opacity keyframe streams as motion Property (motion evaluates), After Effects layer model with default anchor = content centre and default position = identity placement; scene_at(tick), frame_tick(frame), timings(), tile_ref(); declared resample filter bilinear by default (with_filter); TemporalSource impl (lower_frame over a mirroring document graph gives the same matrices)

slice 2: anchor stream (layer space, STU-MOT-013a) and parent chain (STU-MOT-008): content matrix = own transform then every parent's (any affine incl. shear from a non-uniform parent scale under child rotation; parents act at every tick, never pass opacity/blend/matte; bounded walk -> Cycle; a Folio group layer without content is the null parent); CompositionTemporalSource::source_tick = floor((tick - start_time) / stretch) in i128 (equal to Folio StudioLayerTiming::source_tick for tick >= 0, extended to negative ticks, negative stretch reverses, Overflow outside i64); TemporalSource::layer_matrix (default None) lets a source supply the whole content matrix, lower_frame classifies it (exact integer move, singular hides, otherwise pigment transform with the declared filter) and CompositionTemporalSource supplies the scene matrix so the document-graph path honours parents

slice 3 precompositions (STU-MOT-005 composition): CompositionTemporalSource reads every composition reached through precomposition layers (Folio layer = content-less group; unauthored appearance composites normal); the nested composition is evaluated at the layer's source_tick (start_time, rational stretch, reverse), empty outside [0, duration), nested background not drawn (UNVERIFIED AE reading), depth <= MAX_PRECOMP_DEPTH 16; lower_scene renders SceneContent::Precomp through the same backend into an owned surface (SceneSources.surfaces, SHA-256 planes, served by BoundSources) of the nested size, then places it like a one-tile raster layer (layer matrix, opacity, blend mode, declared filter); SceneLimits max_depth 16, max_surfaces 256, max_surface_bytes charged BEFORE allocation; nested exactness merged; refusals composition_precomp_collapse_transformations, composition_precomp_payload, composition_precomp_on_document_graph

slice 4 track mattes (STU-CMP-030/030a, STU-CMP-010 step 7): SceneMatte{layer at the tick or None, Alpha|Luma, inverted}; the adapter reads track_matte (any stack position, one source may serve several layers, source evaluated with its window, opacity, transform, parents and own matte, its visible flag ignored, never rendered on its own per the STU-CMP-030 default); lower_scene renders the matte layer ALONE (normal mode, no background) over the composition rect through the same backend, converts alpha or BT.709 luma x alpha to a coverage_u16le plane round(v*65535) charged before allocation and served by BoundSources::mask, applied as the matted layer's MaskInput (pigment invert, density 1, plan space, not transformed with the layer); ledger track_matte Approximate; absent matte = coverage 0 (exact skip unless inverted); document-graph path refuses matted layers and matte sources (composition_track_matte_on_document_graph)
